I once saw a reddit post claiming that an anime was 'yuri bait'. A series in which the two leads explicitly say that they love each other romantically, and kiss on screen multiple times. the amount of people I’ve seen disparaging/despairing abt The Summer Hikaru Died queerbaiting when it’s straight-up ABOUT the messiness of growing up queer in a small town… Not the intro clocking my whole entire existence I still remember when people tried to argue that Victuuri's kiss was just a platonic hug.. sure.. two boys who are DEF friends that got engaged, not only does the fandom think they are canon but also the show creator. Yuri!!! on Ice is LITERALLYY set in a world where homophobia is not a factor, a deliberate creative choice by the show's co-creator, Mitsurō Kubo. I genuinely couldn't believe it. The lion does not concern themselves with being queer baited as the lion reads unhealthy amounts of fanfiction. The lion is essentially immune to such foolish trickery. Hoyoverse is an interesting case not merely because of the Censorship re: queer content, but also the complete lack of ANY confirmation of relationships. Since they are a gacha company, and some fans are....uh....INFAMOUSLY and violently attached to their favorite characters, they have increasingly avoided confirming ANY sort of relationship between any characters. They have to avoid angering fans that ship themselves/the protagonist with the characters, which I think is called "yumeshippers" or something? But they have to walk that razor line of having characters all appear "available" and interested in the self-insert protagonist while also having some characters that they seem to want to imply could be romantic with each other.
